title: idip_ocr_linkage_schema
description: Mandatory linkage metadata that must be present on every document and result object in both the I-DIP vault and the OCR internal audit store.

request_id.description: Unique request identifier shared by both stores.

document_id.description: Unique document identifier shared by both stores.

source_app.description: The application that initiated the OCR request.

consent_record_ids.description: IDs of the consent records that authorised this processing.
